localizations.name: Warframe mission rewards
localizations.description: What your Warframe mission can give, and when: the next rotation's countdown, its loot rarest first, your Void Fissure relic and the Circuit's tiers, then a short recap. Rates: Digital Extremes, no guarantees. PlayerVox is not affiliated with Digital Extremes.
